inputMethod: Developer button initiates synthetic File/DataTransfer/change, keyboard and click events through actual DOM handlers. Native importer, module Worker, engine and production assets execute unchanged. Worker asset HTTP response deliberately delayed 150 ms; no CPU timing/performance claim.
nativeObservations: A separate real browser filechooser flow selected over-lower-hole.svg from the repository fixture path. Scoped SUPPORT_OUTSIDE_LOWER identified source:art above source:ring, explicit remediation, no current metrics and disabled exports.
Browser locator uncheck Show Ring recovered checked 2 mm height, 2024.6853 mm³ displayed volume, active Base/Unsupported center intervals [0,1.6]/[1.6,2].

At 390x844, native locator click on Move Unsupported center toward top changed order and retained checked 2 mm. Reverse move target measured 94.25x44 CSS px. This is a click/single-pointer alternative check, not touch hardware.
Preview fallback stated 3D preview unavailable throughout, while text measurements/diagnostics/import/editing stayed usable. Browser console had Three.Clock deprecation warnings and no errors.
limits: No native GPU/orbit/frame-rate, physical touch, cross-browser, slicer or physical-print acceptance claimed.

Optional raw CDP touch-emulation permission was declined; no CDP command executed and no workaround attempted. Existing synthetic pointer/control tests plus native click alternatives are the available touch-workflow evidence.

Observer does not alter application state directly: it only observes the private React store and dispatches UI events. That private store-discovery dependency can require adaptation after React changes.

Earlier failed local observer reports are excluded: assumptions about unprefixed IDs and stale payload retention after invalid/successful replacement were corrected. The standalone rapid helper now loads its own fixture.
